cli_actions.title: CLI Actions
cli_actions.intro: Action options tell OrcaSlicer what to *do* with the model(s) it loaded — export, slice, or inspect them. See [CLI Mode](cli_mode) for general flag syntax.

cli_transform.title: CLI Transform
cli_transform.intro: Transform options change the loaded model's geometry or placement before slicing. See [CLI Mode](cli_mode) for general flag syntax.
cli_transform.admonition:
> [!IMPORTANT]
> Transform flags are applied in the order they appear on the command line, not in the order listed on this page. `--rotate 90 --scale 2` rotates then scales; `--scale 2 --rotate 90` scales then rotates. For most of these options the end result is identical either way, but it's worth being deliberate about ordering when combining several.

cli_misc.title: CLI Misc
cli_misc.intro: Options for loading settings/filaments, selecting objects, output locations, logging, and 3MF metadata. See [CLI Mode](cli_mode) for general flag syntax.

group_intro.Loading Settings & Filaments: These load the same per-tab JSON files produced by each settings tab's Save/Export action — see [Export Preset Bundle](import_export#export-preset-bundle) for how those files are created in the GUI.
group_intro.Arrange Behavior: These correspond to options in the GUI's [Auto Arrange](prepare_auto_arrange#parameters) panel.

export_3mf.description: Export the project as a 3MF file.

export_stl.description: Export the model(s) as a single STL.

export_stls.description: Export the model(s) as multiple STLs, one per object, to a directory.

export_slicedata.description: Export slicing data (the sliced result cache) to a folder.

load_slicedata.description: Load previously-cached slicing data from a directory instead of re-slicing.

export_settings.description: Export the current effective process/printer/filament settings to a JSON file.

min_save.description: Export the 3MF with minimum size (strips extra data not needed for printing).

slice.description: Slice the plate(s): `0` = all plates, `i` = plate `i`, any other value is invalid.

mtcpp.description: Maximum triangle count per plate allowed for slicing.

mstpp.description: Maximum slicing time allowed per plate.

no_check.description: Skip validity checks such as G-code path conflict detection.

info.description: Print the loaded model's information (object/instance counts, dimensions, etc.) to stdout.

uptodate.description: Update the config values embedded in a loaded 3MF to the current OrcaSlicer version's defaults/schema.

load_defaultfila.description: For any object without an explicitly loaded filament, use the first filament as its default.

pipe.description: Send slicing progress updates to a named pipe, for integration with external tooling.

arrange.description: Arrange objects on the plate: `0` = disable, `1` = force enable, any other value = auto. See [Auto Arrange](prepare_auto_arrange) for the underlying behavior.

orient.description: Auto-orient objects: `0` = disable, `1` = force enable, any other value = auto. See [Auto Orient](prepare_auto_orient).

ensure_on_bed.description: Lift any object that is partially below the bed so it sits on top of it.

rotate.description: Rotate every loaded object around the Z axis. See [Rotate](prepare_object_manipulation#rotate).

rotate_x.description: Rotate every loaded object around the X axis.

rotate_y.description: Rotate every loaded object around the Y axis.

scale.description: Scale every loaded object by this factor. See [Scale](prepare_object_manipulation#scale).

convert_unit.description: Detect models saved in meters or inches and convert them to millimeters.

repetitions.description: Duplicate the whole model this many times on the plate.
repetitions.notes: Requires [`--slice`](cli_actions#slicing) to target a single plate (not `0`/all-plates). Cannot exceed the plate count.

assemble.description: Merge all loaded models into a single object on one plate, so subsequent actions apply to it as a whole.

load_settings.description: Load process/machine settings from the given file(s), semicolon-separated.

load_filaments.description: Load filament settings from the given file(s), semicolon-separated.

uptodate_settings.description: Process/machine settings to load when used together with [`--uptodate`](cli_actions#misc-actions).

uptodate_filaments.description: Filament settings to load when used together with [`--uptodate`](cli_actions#misc-actions).

downward_check.description: Check whether the current machine is downward-compatible with the machines listed in `--downward-settings`.

downward_settings.description: Machine settings list to check against when `--downward-check` is enabled.

load_custom_gcodes.description: Load a custom G-code toolchange definition from a JSON file. Related concept: [Machine G-code](printer_machine_gcode).

skip_objects.description: Skip the given object indices when printing.

clone_objects.description: Clone count for each object in the load list.

load_filament_ids.description: Filament ID to assign to each loaded object, one entry per input file.
load_filament_ids.notes: List length must match the number of input files.

load_assemble_list.description: Load a full assemble object list (plates, objects, and their parameters) from a config file, instead of loading models directly.
load_assemble_list.notes: Cannot be combined with positional input model files or with any [transform](cli_transform) flag.

datadir.description: Load and store settings at the given directory, instead of the default user config location. Useful for maintaining separate profile sets. Related concept: [Portable User Configuration](how_to_build#portable-user-configuration).

outputdir.notes: Created recursively if it doesn't exist; the process exits with an error if creation fails.

debug.description: Debug logging level: `0` fatal, `1` error, `2` warning, `3` info, `4` debug, `5` trace.

logfile.description: Redirect debug logging to a file instead of stderr.

allow_multicolor_oneplate.description: Allow multiple materials/colors to be arranged onto the same plate. See "Allow multiple materials on same plate" in [Auto Arrange](prepare_auto_arrange#parameters).

allow_rotations.description: Allow arrange to rotate objects to fit. See "Auto rotate for arrangement" in [Auto Arrange](prepare_auto_arrange#parameters).

avoid_extrusion_cali_region.description: Avoid the extrusion calibration region on the plate when arranging.

makerlab_name.description: MakerLab name embedded when generating the 3MF.

makerlab_version.description: MakerLab version embedded when generating the 3MF.

metadata_name.description: Custom metadata field name(s) to add to the 3MF, semicolon-separated.

metadata_value.description: Custom metadata field value(s) to add to the 3MF, semicolon-separated.

enable_timelapse.description: Treat this slicing run as using timelapse. See [Timelapse](others_settings_special_mode#timelapse).

skip_modified_gcodes.description: Skip modified G-code (from printer/filament presets) embedded in a loaded 3MF.

allow_newer_file.description: Allow slicing a 3MF that was saved by a newer OrcaSlicer version than the one running.

allow_mix_temp.description: Allow filaments with high/low temperature requirements to be printed together.
